questions.q: What did Randy Pausch achieve despite his poor eyesight?
questions.why: He created an experiment that flew on NASA's Weightless Wonder.

questions.q: Why did Pausch push his students hard in Building Virtual Worlds?
questions.why: He believed helping others was as rewarding as helping himself.

questions.q: What was a key lesson from Pausch's handbook for group work?
questions.why: The handbook advised learning names and brainstorming before work.

questions.q: Which advice did students find most useful?
questions.why: Students who followed the handbook scored highest.

questions.q: What did Pausch say about giving to others?
questions.why: He claimed helping others gives as much satisfaction as helping oneself.
